quotes.text: "Wisdom lies between foolish hope and bitter withdrawal. Send neither everything nor nothing.
So the village sent two stones—not the three of blind trust, nor the fragment of abandonment.
Respond to improvement with improvement.
The bridge no longer requires conscious effort—cooperation has become your nature.
"The bridge no longer needs my watchful eye. You have internalized the wisdom
Now, in the eighth season, the bridge stands strong.

note: Earth Keeper: after silence send measured two stones, neither all nor nothing; trust rebuilt season by season until cooperation becomes nature.
